strings.name: Adi Shamir
strings.summary: Adi Shamir co-invented RSA with Ron Rivest and Leonard Adleman and introduced influential methods including secret sharing. He also investigates how cryptographic systems fail, developing differential cryptanalysis with Eli Biham. His research joins construction with cryptanalysis across identification, signatures and side-channel attacks, demonstrating the need for continuing public examination of security claims.
strings.coverageNote: Research checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2017. This is not a daily news archive. Shared achievements are credited to collaborators and teams.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-invented RSA and advanced cryptanalysis and secret-sharing research, profoundly influencing modern information security.

strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Tel Aviv University mathematics bachelor's (1973); Weizmann Institute master's (1975), PhD (1977)
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Public keys and secret sharing
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Co-invented RSA and introduced a threshold method for distributing a secret among multiple parties.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Cryptanalysis
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Developed differential cryptanalysis with Biham and studied side-channel leakage through caches and sound.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Japan Prize
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Recognized for pioneering contributions to cryptography and information security.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Israel Prize
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Received the national prize for contributions to computer science.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Shared Turing Award
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Honored with Rivest and Adleman for public-key cryptography.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Differential cryptanalysis
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Published work with Eli Biham on differential analysis of DES-like cryptosystems.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Secret-sharing scheme
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Published How to Share a Secret, allowing a threshold of participants to reconstruct a secret.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: RSA paper
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Published a digital-signature and public-key method with Rivest and Adleman.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Weizmann doctorate
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Earned his computer-science PhD before postdoctoral research at MIT.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Mathematics bachelor's degree
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Graduated from Tel Aviv University before graduate study at Weizmann.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Born in Tel Aviv
